visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A light-beige duck with an orange beak stands centered on a grey-and-white speckled terrazzo floor, looking curiously around. (2) The camera zooms out and pans slightly, revealing the legs of several round metal stools and a vast expanse of the tiled floor. (3) The camera tilts upwards to focus on a large red and yellow illuminated sign featuring an image of a white duck and traditional Chinese text; behind a counter, two women wearing glasses are visible in a brightly lit kitchen area. (4) A person wearing a black beanie, a denim jacket, and khaki cargo pants sits at a metal table; a duck stands at their feet on a small purple and blue towel while four white question marks appear as a graphic overlay above the person's head. (5) Two ducks—one beige and one with brown and white speckled feathers—walk across the speckled floor near the legs of a seated customer. (6) The camera follows the ducks as they enter a kitchen-like area with white tiled walls and floor; the ducks peck at a green plastic bowl and scattered green leafy vegetable scraps. (7) A man in a black t-shirt with a graphic of two ducks and the text 'what duck?' appears momentarily while looking towards the ducks. (8) The two ducks continue walking through the establishment, passing behind the legs of a staff member dressed in black near metal kitchen equipment and prep tables.
